market_summary: London session shows prevailing bearish pressure across XAUUSD, EURUSD, and GBPUSD with prices holding under VWAP/EMA50 near daily lows, though lacking RVOL expansion for aggressive breakdown entries. US100 maintains a strong bullish structure above VWAP, offering an intrabar dip-buy near EMA20 support. BTCUSD remains range-bound around fair value POC.

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 4040.14, VAH 4058.71) and trading below POC 4044.58. CVD is BEARISH (-1.65) with negative slope (-0.19), agreeing with the downward pressure. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price rejected below EMA20 (4048.81), EMA50 (4049.74), and VWAP (4048.50). Low volume (RVOL 0.934, no recent yellow spike) near the lower ATR band (4039.02) and Session Low support (4026.41) suggests limited breakdown momentum currently.
signals.level_event: rejection at lower ATR band / VAL area

signals.rationale: Price is inside Value Area (VAL 1.11307, VAH 1.11598) right at VAL, and below POC 1.11374. CVD is NEUTRAL (-1926) with fading positive slope. LONDON_SESSION context. Waiting for a clean breakout or mean-reversion pull-back.

Volume is moderate (RVOL 0.795) without yellow volume confirmation, risking a liquidity sweep/fakeout near Prev Low (1.33119).
signals.level_event: breakout below VAL, testing Prev Low 1.33119

signals.rationale: Price is inside Value Area (VAL 28060.92, VAH 28302.45) but traded near VAH and above POC 28121.30. CVD is BULLISH (+8.56). Session is LONDON_SESSION.
